params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Filter messages by conversation ID.

params.name: created_after
params.description: If provided, will only return objects created after this datetime.

params.name: created_before
params.description: If provided, will only return objects created before this datetime.

params.name: cursor
params.description: The pagination cursor value.

params.name: include_deleted_data
params.description: Indicates whether or not this object has been deleted in the third party platform. Full coverage deletion detection is a premium add-on. Native deletion detection is offered for free with limited coverage. [Learn more](https://docs.merge.dev/integrations/hris/supported-features/).

params.name: include_remote_data
params.description: Whether to include the original data Merge fetched from the third-party to produce these models.

params.name: include_shell_data
params.description: Whether to include shell records. Shell records are empty records (they may contain some metadata but all other fields are null).

params.name: modified_after
params.description: If provided, only objects synced by Merge after this date time will be returned.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: If provided, only objects synced by Merge before this date time will be returned.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Overrides the default ordering for this endpoint. Possible values include: remote_created_at, -remote_created_at.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page. The maximum limit is 100.

params.name: remote_id
params.description: The API provider's ID for the given object.

params.name: root_message
params.description: If provided as 'true', will only return root messages (messages without a parent message).
